--[[@sn]] self:gen("Endless Knob")--[[@sen]] self:epmo(1)self:epv0(50)self:epmi(0)self:epma(127)self:epse(50)--[[@cb]] function setJogLed(val)for i=5,9,1 do local intensity,lednum=gsc(i - 5,val,0,127),i glp(lednum,2,intensity)end end

--[[@sn]] self:gen("Play/Stop")--[[@cb]] TOGGLE_UI={new=function(self,name,clr,animate)local instance=setmetatable({},{__index=self})instance.val=0 instance.name=name instance.state=false instance.clr=clr instance.animate=animate or false instance.defclr={50,50,50}return instance end,render=function(self)local c=self.val==1 and self.clr or self.defclr if self.animate==true and self.val==1 then self.state=not self.state c[1]=self.state and 255 or 0 end self.parent.lcd:ldaf(self.x,self.y,self.x + self.w,self.y + self.h,c)self.parent.lcd:ldft(self.val,self.x + 4,self.y + 4,16,{255,255,255})self.parent.lcd:ldft(self.name,self.x + 4,self.y + self.h - 20,16,{255,255,255})self.change=false end,set=function(self,par)self.change=true self.val=par and 1 or 0 end,}function requestState()gps("package-ableton-js","request_full_state")end

--[[@sn]] self:gen("Record")--[[@cb]] RANGE_UI={new=function(self,n,clr,fs)local inst=setmetatable({},{__index=self})inst.val=0 inst.n=n inst.clr=clr inst.defclr={50,50,50}inst.nv=0 inst.fs=fs ~=nil and fs or 16 return inst end,render=function(self)self.parent.lcd:ldaf(self.x,self.y,self.x + self.w,self.y + self.h,self.defclr)if self.h > self.w then local fh=math.floor(self.nv * self.h)self.parent.lcd:ldaf(self.x,self.y + self.h - fh,self.x + self.w,self.y + self.h,self.clr)else local fw=math.floor(self.nv * self.w)self.parent.lcd:ldaf(self.x,self.y,self.x + fw,self.y + self.h,self.clr)end self.parent.lcd:ldft(self.val,self.x + 4,self.y + 4,self.fs,gW)self.parent.lcd:ldft(self.n,self.x + 4,self.y + self.h - 20,16,gW)self.change=false end,set=function(self,params)self.nv=params.nv self.val=(params.nv * 100)// 1 self.change=true if params.name ~=nil then self.n=params.name end end,}

--[[@sn]] self:gen("Left")--[[@cb]] TRACK_UI={new=function(self)local instance=setmetatable({},{__index=self})instance.name="" instance.color={50,50,50}instance.val=0 return instance end,render=function(self)self.parent.lcd:ldaf(self.x,self.y,self.x + self.w,self.y + self.h,self.color)self.parent.lcd:ldft(self.name,self.x + 4,self.y + 4,16,{255,255,255})self.change=false end,set=function(self,params)self.name=params.name self.color=params.color self.val=params.val self.change=true end,}

--[[@sn]] self:gen("Right")--[[@cb]] function ableton_js_callback(p)local evt=p["evt"]if evt=="RT_TRANSPORT" then recWg:set(p.recording)elseif evt=="RT_MUTE" then local v=not p.v muteWg:set(v)ele[4]:glp(1,v and 255 or 0)elseif evt=="RT_SOLO" then soloWg:set(p.v)ele[5]:glp(1,p.v and 255 or 0)elseif evt=="RT_ARM" then armWg:set(p.v)ele[6]:glp(1,p.v and 255 or 0)elseif evt=="RT_INFO" then if p.isMidi==true then volWg:set({nv=0})panWg:set({nv=0})end trackWg:set(p)elseif evt=="RT_VOL" then volWg:set(p)setJogLed(p.nv * 127)elseif evt=="RT_PLAYING_CLIP" then clipWg:set(p)elseif evt=="RT_PAN" then panWg:set(p)elseif evt=="RT_PARAM" then paramWg:set(p)elseif evt=="RT_SEND" then if p.si==0 then sendaWg:set(p)elseif p.si==1 then sendbWg:set(p)end end end

--[[@cb]] Layout={new=function(self)local instance=setmetatable({},{__index=self})return instance end,addWidget=function(self,cx,cy,wg)wg.w=self.width / self.r // 1 wg.h=self.height / self.c // 1 wg.x=self.x + cx * wg.w // 1 wg.y=self.y + cy * wg.h // 1 wg.parent=self local ci=cy * self.r + cx self.cells[ci]=wg return wg end,initialize=function(self,lcd,hcc,vcc,x,y,w,h)self.lcd=lcd self.r=hcc self.c=vcc self.width=w self.height=h self.x=x self.y=y self.cells={}for i=0,hcc * vcc - 1 do self.cells[i]={}end end,render=function(self)for i=0,self.r * self.c - 1 do local cell=self.cells[i]if type(cell.render)=="function" and cell.change==true then cell:render()end end self.lcd:ldsw()end,}
